notes.title: Working on it!!!
notes.notes: [p]Hi,[/p][p][/p][p]Well, a lot happened during the development of this game, but hey, finally I can see the light at the end of the tunnel.[/p][p][/p][p]The game is currently being updated to the newest Unity version for better compatibility, the new content is coming along nicely...[/p][p][/p][p]I still have a few months to properly finish the game, and the expected release date will be January 2026.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for your support!, Alex[/p]

notes.title: We're almost there!
notes.notes:
Hey there fellow adventurers!,

Well, the game has been stalled for a while as you can see. I had bad luck with some deals I've signed and that frozen the development of the game.
I expect to close this deal by the end of the year 2025 so I can resume work and move the game from the early access to the final version.
Stay tuned!

notes.title: 0.54 bug fixes
notes.notes:
Hi,

-Fixed bug when creating a level, Add loot made the editor crash (thus the game).

Have fun!

-Fixed invisible walls in some levels

On the other hand, the new dungeons are progressing really well, the new 3 characters... stay tuned, a big update is coming :)
-Removed some debug panels which were left activated hiding part of the screen

notes.title: Patch 0.51
notes.notes:
Hi,

This version fixes a nasty bug which will delete your level progress and you have to start over playing all the levels again.

If your progress was lost there's nothing that can be done at this point. If you never downloaded version 0.5, then this version will keep your level progress as expected.

I'm so sorry for the inconvenience  :(

notes.title: 0.50 tutorials added
notes.notes:
Hi there!,

A new update is here!. I've added tutorials for both the game and the level editor. Let me know what do you think or if you find bugs please report.

In the mean time stay tuned, I'm preparing a huge release with the new dungeons, enemies, etc, etc.

Have fun!

notes.title: Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hi!,

Here's a list with the roadmap planned, do not hesitate to send suggestions, I will consider all of them.

Right now what's in the list is:

-3 new playable characters
-3 new dungeons
-5 new enemies
-3 traps
-modified UI
-new sounds
-overall polish of special effects
-tutorial for the game 
-tutorial for the editor

Those are the things will be part of the final release to leave early access. I will be releasing updates gradually during the first quarter to have all that's in the list ready.

Remember, the price will be raised by that time. So, grab the game while is cheap :)

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Dwarf's Adventure is here!
notes.notes:
Welcome to Dwarf's Adventure!

As you can see this is an early access game, which means I plan to update the game with new features, content and much more polished graphics.
Stay tuned for updates :) 

I'm here to listen all your feedback, then chose what kind of things can be added to the game to improve the overall experience.

Feel free to share your thoughts!


Here's the roadmap for the early access in no particular order:

-3 new playable characters
-more traps
-more enemies
-new UI
-new menu image
-more sound effects 
-new tilesets (aka dungeons)
-guided tutorial
